title: Replacing Judges with Juries: Evaluating LLM Generations with a Panel of Diverse Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the methodology of using a panel of LLMs (PoLL) to evaluate model performance and reduce intra-model bias. While some specific examples of question-answering in the appendix mention theology or religious history (e.g., Vaishnava Theology or Irish Catholic immorality), these are individual items from general-purpose datasets (KILT, HotPotQA) used to test the evaluator, and the paper does not specifically target or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
